integrity: The published polygon-extension theorem is used as the structural input. Every regular extension is then computed from side-line intersections, and the illumination parameter is obtained by an exact triangle-minus-polygon-cap area calculation. A standalone convex-hull checker replays finite instances only as a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The complete spectrum is proved for regular polygons and transfers affinely to affinely regular polygons. It does not settle the converse characterization problem for arbitrary convex polygons.
title: Complete homothetic illumination spectrum of regular polygons
